study.title: Crop and Weed Segmentation Using ResNet-Unet Architecture
study.venue: 2024 First International Conference on Data, Computation and Communication (ICDCC)

dataset.name: Self-collected UAV sorghum field dataset (Southern Germany)
dataset.note: DJI Mavic 2 Pro + 20 MP Hasselblad L1D-20c, 5472x3648 px, height 5 m, nadir, 10% capture overlap; sorghum 'Farmsughro 180', row spacing 37.5 cm, 25 seeds/m2, BBCH 17; weed species mostly dicots: Onopordum acanthium, Chenopodium album, Matricaria chamomilla, Thlaspi arvense, Veronica officinalis; resized to 256x256 inputs with augmentation (flips/rotations/RGB shifts) + CLAHE + gamma correction; additional test_1 (early stage, 110 patches) and test_2 (advanced stage, 110 patches) held-out sets.

segmentation.backbone: ResNet-50 (encoder) + UNet decoder with skip connections

mIoU.ambiguity: Only Dice, precision/recall/F1, and accuracy reported.

F1.ambiguity: Macro-averaged 3-class F1 (background 0.9986, sorghum 0.8876, weed 0.7948). Test-set macro-F1 (Table III): test_1 0.8506, test_2 0.8442. Abstract range 93.01%-99.68% mixes macro precision and weighted F1.
